title: WP900 G8 condition-blind observer still permits caller-injected reentry tautology
target_boundary: fresh symmetric condition-blind reentry observation ABI -> matched mechanism comparison -> later exact target execution

finding.source_behavior: ReentryObservationWindowRecorder.observe_reentry accepts only caller-supplied reentry_ref and reentry_sha256 and unconditionally appends a REENTRY event. The recorder does not verify event-factory origin, producer identity, membership in an independently observed event stream, causal parent/opportunity binding, or a task/runtime event identity before setting the eventual receipt status to REENTRY_OBSERVED.
finding.test_behavior: test_g8_injected_reentry_cannot_false_green_as_control_absence proves that an injected call changes the receipt to REENTRY_OBSERVED, but it does not prevent a caller from making that call conditionally for only one experimental arm. The public observer ABI is condition-blind, while the caller can still remain condition-aware.
finding.scope: This does not falsify the repository implementation as a generic event recorder. It falsifies using the current recorder output alone as independent/non-circular reentry evidence unless the event source that invokes observe_reentry is itself independently bound and condition-blind.

counterexample.setup: Run two otherwise matched windows with identical source/input/pre-state/executor/opportunity identities. Let orchestration know the arm condition. In the intervention arm only, call observe_reentry(reentry_ref='reentry:observed', reentry_sha256=<valid-looking digest>) without any independently observed downstream reentry event. Close both windows normally.
counterexample.observed_current_result: The intervention receipt becomes REENTRY_OBSERVED and the control receipt becomes NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED_IN_COMPLETE_WINDOW. bind_matched_reentry_mechanism therefore returns MECHANISM_REENTRY_DIFFERENCE_CANDIDATE even though the difference was supplied by the condition-aware caller rather than independently observed from runtime behavior.

required_closure.preferred_architecture: Do not create a second truth or event authority. Bind G8 to an existing typed/runtime event source or existing GwtRuntimeWitness-style recorder/factory whose event origin is independently validated. The condition-blind observation component should consume or validate an event object/source membership; a condition-aware caller must not be able to mint a valid matching reentry merely by invoking observe_reentry with arbitrary strings.
minimum_event_binding: factory/recorder origin or equivalent non-forgeable-in-protocol provenance
event digest over canonical payload rather than an arbitrary caller-provided digest
evidence that the event was received from the bound event source inside the open window
required_regressions: A condition-aware caller that directly invokes the public reentry-recording method for only one arm must not be sufficient to produce an admissible matched mechanism difference.
A syntactically valid reentry_ref/reentry_sha256 pair with no valid event-factory/source membership must fail closed.
A reentry event from a different task, producer, runtime instance, opportunity or observation window must fail closed even if its digest is valid.
An unexpected genuine control-side reentry from the same independently bound source must remain REENTRY_OBSERVED and prevent a false control-absence claim.
Incomplete event-source/readback evidence must classify UNKNOWN/EVIDENCE_INVALID rather than NO_REENTRY_OBSERVED.

anti_duplication: This packet is REVIEW_ONLY/CANDIDATE_FALSIFIER. It does not mutate WP900 G8 owned source, tests, workflow, active pointer, receipts or reconciliation. Current G8 mutation owner should absorb or reject it against executable evidence.
next_exact_action: WP900 G8 mutation owner should add an independently bound event-source/origin fence and the caller-injection hard negative before repository acceptance. If the current design already binds observe_reentry to such a source outside this module, cite and regress that exact path instead of adding new authority. After repository closure, bind at most one exact G8 owner-VPS runtime subject.
